comment: The Software Center's AI Agents page (ADR 0023). Every attr must exist in the package index; the package's build checks it. Unfree ones need tulsi.daemon.unfreeAgents.

sections.title: Coding agents in the terminal
sections.intro: Each needs an account or an API key with its company; some can also use local models.

sections.title: Agent IDEs
sections.intro: Graphical editors built around an agent.

sections.title: Run models on this computer
sections.intro: Private and offline, if your hardware is up to it. Check what fits first.

agents.name: OpenCode
agents.needs: Any provider's API key, or a local model
agents.blurb: Open-source terminal agent that works with many model providers.

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.blurb: Anthropic's agentic coding tool for the terminal.

agents.name: Codex CLI
agents.needs: ChatGPT account or OpenAI API key
agents.blurb: OpenAI's lightweight coding agent for the terminal.

agents.name: Gemini CLI
agents.needs: Google account or Gemini API key
agents.blurb: Google's open-source agent that brings Gemini to the terminal.

agents.name: Qwen Code
agents.needs: Qwen account or an OpenAI-compatible API
agents.blurb: Terminal agent tuned for the Qwen coder models.

agents.name: Aider
agents.needs: Any provider's API key, or a local model
agents.blurb: Pair programming in the terminal, committing each change to git.

agents.name: Goose
agents.needs: Any provider's API key, or a local model
agents.blurb: Open-source, extensible agent that can install, run, edit and test.

agents.name: Crush
agents.needs: Any provider's API key, or a local model
agents.blurb: A glamorous terminal coding agent from the makers of Bubble Tea.

agents.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
agents.blurb: GitHub Copilot's coding agent in the terminal.

agents.name: Amp
agents.blurb: Agentic coding tool, in the terminal.

agents.name: Google Antigravity
agents.blurb: Agent-first development platform: an editor built around agents.

agents.name: Antigravity Hub
agents.blurb: Desktop app for running several agents across separate projects.

agents.name: Ollama
agents.needs: Enough memory for a model (see the check)
agents.blurb: Download and run open models with one command. Start it with “ollama serve”, then “ollama run MODEL”.

agents.name: llama.cpp
agents.needs: A GGUF model file (see the check)
agents.blurb: The fast C/C++ engine under many runners: llama-cli, and llama-server with a web chat.
